title: feat(console): the install result says when a package was installed without a protocol compatibility check
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWZ1wrAZ2ocZovnByy
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQyjmnvpHKvXkkGLK7ES5aE)_

Fixes #30326

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台三处安装结果（应用市场软件包详情页「安装」、应用市场目录的组织软件包安装、设置 → 软件包 → 导入）在安装成功的句子下多一行琥珀色提醒：该软件包未声明它支持的平台协议版本（或声明了无法识别的范围），因此安装时没有做兼容性检查，可能无法在当前平台版本上正常运行。按读者语言显示（10 种语言），点名软件包、安装时的平台协议版本，以及无法识别的范围。
- 为什么改：服务端那一半（PR #30409）已经在安装应答里带上 `data.protocolCheckSkipped`，但控制台只读成功字段，管理员看不到服务器日志，这条提醒被丢掉了。
- 风险与回滚：只在应答带这个字段时多一行字；检查过范围的安装一字不变；不认识的 reason 原样显示服务端英文句子；回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/protocolCheckSkipped.ts`（读字段、选词条）、`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 的 `doInstallLocal`（四个成功分支都带上提醒）、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` 的 `protocolCheckSkipped`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/protocolCheckSkipped-30326.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.importProtocolCheckSkipped-30326.test.tsx`，预期 8 个用例全绿（需先建 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的依赖闭包）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Card #30326, the **ui half**. The server half landed in PR #30409 (`60fe44fdc`): `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` answers `data.protocolCheckSkipped` on a success answer when the ADR-0087 D1 handshake admitted the package without checking its range, and omits it otherwise.

- **Reader.** New `console/marketplace/protocolCheckSkipped.ts`, modelled on `dependencyMissing.ts`: `protocolCheckSkippedText(answer, t)` draws one key per `reason` (`no-range`, `unparsed-range`) from the notice's facts (`packageId`, `protocolVersion`, and `requiredRange` for `unparsed-range`). A `reason` this Console does not know, or an `unparsed-range` without its range, draws the server's `message` as given. An answer without the field draws nothing. `useProtocolCheckSkippedText()` binds it to the current locale.
- **The line.** New `ProtocolCheckSkippedNote.tsx`: an amber caution line with a warning icon, drawn inside the existing result note under its own sentence, since the install did succeed.
- **The three surfaces.**
  - Package page Install (`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`, `localResult`): every success answer carries it, managed loaded now, managed loaded at restart, unmanaged copy, and the "asked for a copy, installed managed" note.
  - Catalog org install (`MarketplacePage.tsx`, `orgMsg`), the `installLocal` path.
  - Setup → Packages → Import (`metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx`, `importMsg`).
- **Types.** `LocalManagedInstallResult` and `LocalUnmanagedInstallResult` gain the optional `protocolCheckSkipped` (`marketplaceApi.ts`).
- **i18n (the widening).** `marketplace.install.protocolCheckSkipped.noRange` and `.unparsedRange` in all 10 locale packs. Import reuses these through the shared hook, as it already does for `DEPENDENCY_MISSING`, so no `engine.packages.*` row is added.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30326-install-result-protocol-check-skipped.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-sukiom`, not `claude/issue-30326-*`; the card is #30326.

## Tests

Four new files, 14 cases:

- `protocolCheckSkipped-30326.test.ts` (5): no-range facts; unparsed-range facts incl. the range; unknown reason draws the server message; unparsed-range without a range draws the server message; CONTROL: no field, null, undefined, nothing readable draw nothing.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.protocolCheckSkipped-30326.test.tsx` (4): managed loaded, managed loaded at restart, unmanaged with an unreadable range; CONTROL: a checked install draws no line. The real `marketplaceApi` client, one stubbed `fetch`.
- `MarketplacePage.orgInstallProtocolCheckSkipped-30326.test.tsx` (2): org install draws the line; CONTROL: none when checked.
- `PackagesPage.importProtocolCheckSkipped-30326.test.tsx` (3): the REAL locale packs, zh no-range sentence and en unparsed-range sentence; CONTROL: none when checked.

## Acceptance notes

- A standing protocol display on the package detail page is out of scope (claim): after install no read serves the field back, so there is nothing to draw it from outside the install answer.
- The other install door, `POST /api/v1/packages`, answers no notice yet; that is #30412 (server). `os package install` does not print the notice either (noted by the server half's report).
- Live screenshots cover the Import surface only: this rig has no cloud marketplace (`cloudUrl` empty), so the package page and the org catalog cannot install from a catalog here. Those two are covered by the tests above, on the wire shape the live server answered.

## Verification

Gates and tests ran on `a58846c5`; the head adds an evidence commit and its removal, the tree is byte-identical (`git diff a58846c5 HEAD` is empty). Base `b6caa141`.

<details><summary>Live rig and screenshots (zh-CN, 1440 wide)</summary>

`examples/app-showcase` `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on a private port, the console via `vite` in `ui/apps/console` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`, Chromium, browser locale zh-CN. The live door, read back before any UI work:

- `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with `{"manifest":{"id":"com.acme.probe","version":"1.0.0","type":"app"}}` answered `protocolCheckSkipped: {reason: "no-range", packageId: "com.acme.probe", protocolVersion: "18.0.0", message: "Package 'com.acme.probe' does not state which platform protocol it supports, ..."}`.
- The same with `engines: {protocol: "whatever-1"}` answered `reason: "unparsed-range"`, `requiredRange: "whatever-1"`, `rangeSource: "engines.protocol"`.

Before (the reader held to draw nothing with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold`, restored after, blob equals HEAD): only `已导入 "com.acme.legacy-before"。刷新应用切换器后即可使用。`

![before import](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/136df32ac33dff042165a9fd3c3edaa30fb90d88/evidence/30326/before-import-zh-1440.png?raw=true)

After: the same sentence, then `com.acme.legacy-crm 未声明它支持的平台协议版本，因此已在平台协议 18.0.0 下安装，未做兼容性检查，可能无法在当前平台版本上正常运行。声明了所支持协议（engines.protocol）的软件包版本会在安装时接受检查。`

![after import](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/136df32ac33dff042165a9fd3c3edaa30fb90d88/evidence/30326/after-import-zh-1440.png?raw=true)
